convoLines.text: "What's something from your old life that's actually useful here? That's the whole of it."
"Okay." Something shutters, just slightly.
"Still on your useful old-life skills."
"Alright. But I'm not carrying your stuff."
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"Huh. Let me think about that." "You're family now. Chosen family — the kind that actually counts." "That's where we are."
"People here talk. What they say about you when you're not at the fire — that's the real answer to your question."
"Trust is slow out here. It's the one thing the System can't grant us."
"I should go. You know where to find me."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"This one — Water Lily. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."
«হ্যাঁ, হ্যাঁ, ঠিক।» — Fatima translates: "Yes, yes, right." They nod back, slowly.
«তুমি সত্যিই ভালো মানুষ।» — Fatima translates: "You're truly a good person." A grin breaks through, quick and warm.
«সব ঠিক হয়ে যাবে।» — Fatima translates: "Everything will be okay." You tap your chest, then theirs. Us. They nod, emphatic.
You listen hard, watching their mouth shape the words. «বুঝতে পারছো?» — Fatima translates: "Can you understand?"
«তুমি কি... এখানকার প্রধান?» — Fatima translates: "Are you... the chief here?"

Xue tilts their head. "...What?" You try again, slower, redder. A long beat. Then the smallest smile. "হ্যাঁ, হ্যাঁ, ঠিক।," they say — perfectly. "You meant." They knew all along; they just wanted to watch you work for it.
Something in them almost softens — then doesn't. Not yet.
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"This was good." They mean it.
